newsitem.title: USA: Datum files for 1.7-mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Datum files for 1.7-mln shr offering.

text.p: Datum Inc said Monday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed public offering of 1.7 million common shares.
Of the total, it said it will sell 1.0 million shares while certain security holders will offer 700,000 shares.
The offering will be made through Hambrecht & Quist LLC,, Oppenheimer & Co., Inc. and Van Kasper & Co, it said.
Net proceeds will used for general corporate purposes, including working capital, it said.

Datum designs, manufactures and markets time and frequency products used to synchronize the flow of information in telecommunications networks. It also supplies precise timing products for enterprise computing networks and a wide variety of space, scientific and industrial test and measurement applications.
